front: Why are spectrogram axes not interchangeable?
back: A time shift keeps the sound's identity; a frequency shift changes the sound. Rectangular kernels and time-only shifts are natural.

front: Precision, recall and F1 of class $a$

back: Macro F1 averages class F1 equally, so rare-class failures show up; accuracy can be 0.95 with a useless model.
Exclusive balanced: top-1/top-5. Multi-label (AudioSet): mAP. Imbalanced: per-class recall and macro F1.

front: Two rules for a good augmentation
back: It must not change the information used for the label, and it should mimic real distortions.
